name: 32829 · Orlando, FL
findings: ZIP 32829 (Orlando) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32829 (Orlando) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32829 (Orlando) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).
